Frequently Asked Questions
Are the PDFs free? ▾
Many PDFs are completely free. Pass editions start at ₹39. You can download free PDFs without any payment.
How do I download a PDF? ▾
Click any PDF card, then click "Free Download" or "Buy Now". Free PDFs are instant; paid ones use secure Razorpay checkout.
What exams do you cover? ▾
ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, Current Affairs, General Knowledge, and more — all focused on Assam government examinations.
Is payment secure? ▾
Yes. All transactions are processed via Razorpay with 256-bit SSL encryption. We never store your card details.
Can I access purchased PDFs offline? ▾
Yes. Once downloaded, PDFs work completely offline. Studyria also works as a PWA — install it to your phone for offline access.

📋 Creator Agreement
Studyria Creator Program — Terms & Conditions 1. Revenue Share: Creators earn based on their tier — Starter 60%, Rising 65%, Pro 70%. Studyria retains the remaining platform fee to cover infrastructure, support, and operations.

2. Content Ownership: You retain full ownership of all PDFs you upload. By submitting, you grant Studyria a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, sell, and distribute your content on the platform.

3. Originality & Copyright: All uploaded PDFs must be entirely your original work. Submitting plagiarised, copied, or unlicensed third-party content will result in immediate removal of the content and suspension of your account without prior notice.

4. Quality Standards: PDFs must achieve a minimum quality score of 60/100 as evaluated by the Studyria Smart Verification system. PDFs that do not meet this threshold will be rejected.

5. Withdrawals & Payments: Minimum withdrawal threshold is ₹500. Requests are processed within 7 business days via Bank Transfer or UPI. Studyria is not liable for delays caused by third-party payment providers.

6. Anti-Spam & Duplicate Content: Duplicate PDF submissions are automatically detected and rejected by our system. Repeated violations will lead to permanent account suspension.

7. Automatic Level Upgrades: Creator tiers are upgraded automatically based on cumulative total sales — Rising: ₹5,000+ · Pro: ₹25,000+

8. Review & Approval Process: All creator applications and PDF submissions are reviewed by the Studyria admin team within 3–5 business days. Studyria reserves the right to reject any submission without providing a reason.

9. Tax Compliance: Creators are solely responsible for declaring and paying any applicable income tax on revenue earned through Studyria. Earnings statements will be provided on request.

10. Account Conduct: You agree not to attempt to manipulate download counts, ratings, or any platform metrics. Any fraudulent activity will result in immediate account termination and forfeiture of pending earnings.

11. Modifications: Studyria reserves the right to update these terms at any time with a minimum of 7 days' prior notice. Continued use of the Creator Program after the notice period constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2026

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, and payment details when you create an account or make a purchase. We also automatically collect usage data including pages visited, features used, and device information to improve our service.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve Studyria, process transactions, send you transactional and promotional communications, and comply with legal obligations. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

3. Data Storage & Security

Your data is stored securely using Supabase infrastructure with industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest. We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, loss, or disclosure.

4. Cookies

We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings; note that disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You can manage most data directly from your Dashboard. To request full account deletion or data export, contact us at studyria24@gmail.com.

6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notice. Continued use of Studyria after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

7. Contact

For any privacy-related questions, please email studyria24@gmail.com or use our Contact page.

Terms of Service

Last updated: June 2026

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using Studyria you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our platform.

2. Use of the Platform

Studyria is an educational content platform. You may access and download PDF study materials for your personal, non-commercial educational use only. You may not redistribute, resell, or reproduce any paid content without explicit written permission from Studyria.

3. Account Responsibilities

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorised use of your account.

4. Intellectual Property

All content on Studyria, including PDFs, graphics, logos, and software, is the property of Studyria or its content creators and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Creator-submitted content remains the intellectual property of the creator.

5. Payments & Purchases

All purchases are processed securely through Razorpay. Prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) inclusive of applicable taxes. Please review our Refund Policy for details on cancellations and refunds.

6. Limitation of Liability

Studyria is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising out of your use of the platform. Our maximum liability to you shall not exceed the amount you paid in the 3 months preceding the claim.

7. Modifications

We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time with at least 7 days' notice. Continued use of Studyria after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

8. Governing Law

These Terms shall be governed by the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Guwahati, Assam.

Refund Policy

Last updated: June 2026

💚

Our Commitment

We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you are not happy with a PDF you've purchased, we'll refund you — no questions asked — within the eligibility window.

Eligibility

You are eligible for a full refund if you request it within 7 days of your purchase date and you have not downloaded the PDF more than once. Refund requests after 7 days will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

How to Request a Refund

Email us at studyria24@gmail.com with your order ID (found in your Dashboard → Purchases) and a brief reason. We process all valid refund requests within 3–5 business days.

Refund Method

Refunds are credited to the original payment method (UPI, card, wallet, or net banking). Processing time after approval: UPI/Wallets — 1–2 business days; Cards — 5–7 business days; Net Banking — 3–5 business days.

Non-Refundable Cases

Refunds are not available for: subscriptions after the first 48 hours of a new billing cycle, PDFs that have been shared with others in violation of our Terms, or accounts suspended for Terms of Service violations.

Our Story

Studyria was born from a simple observation: quality study material for Assam's competitive exams — ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET — was scattered, expensive, or simply unavailable in digital form for students across Assam. We set out to fix that by building a single, beautiful platform where the best PDFs from the best educators meet every student who needs them.

Our Mission

To democratise access to premium educational content for students across Assam and India. Every student — regardless of location or financial situation — deserves access to the best study material. That's why we offer a mix of free and affordable premium content, and a creator program that lets educators earn while they teach.

Our Platform

Studyria is a Progressive Web App — install it like a native app on Android or iOS, read your PDFs offline, get job alerts via Career Hub, and track your progress through your personalised Dashboard. Everything works beautifully on any device, fast.

Join Us

Are you an educator, author, or subject expert? Join our Creator Program and earn up to 80% revenue share on every PDF you publish. Have questions? Get in touch.

Frequently Asked Questions
Got questions? We have answers.
Studyria Pass gives you unlimited access to all Pass Notes on Studyria for the duration of your plan. Choose a plan, complete payment, and get instant access — no waiting, no approval needed.
No. PDFs you purchase individually are yours forever — lifetime access that never expires, regardless of your membership status. Purchased PDFs and Membership access are completely independent.
Yes! You can renew anytime — even after your Pass expires. Your access restores immediately upon renewal and all Pass Notes become accessible again instantly.
No. Pass plans are one-time payments for a fixed duration — there is no auto-renewal or recurring charge. Your Pass simply expires at the end of the period. You can choose to renew or not.
Yes! All new Pass Notes added to Studyria are automatically included in your Pass — at no extra cost. Your plan always covers the complete catalog.
If you are preparing for an upcoming exam, the Quarterly (3-Month) plan offers the best balance of savings and access. For maximum value and serious preparation, the 6-Month plan gives you everything at the lowest per-day cost.
